card.name: The word settlement
card.fires_on: The word "settlement" (or "Settlement") in its noun senses: a place where people settled, the act of settling land, and a legal or financial settlement.

modes.label: Place or colonization
modes.description: Settlement as a community or the act of people settling an area, in history or geography.

card.plain: It lights up on the word "settlement", whether it means a town, people settling land, or a legal deal.
